hotel_name: Mauryan Signature Hotel With Airport View

positive_snippets: budget stay! For just ₹1000, the room was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. Great value for money, friendly staff, and convenient location.

Good place to stay, good stay.
The view from the hotel is worth it.
Overall experience of staying here was great. Much recommend.
negative_snippets: Broken door lock and the TV was also broken (visible in the video). The room was very dirty. The staff was not cooperative at all. Even after I requested a room change, they refused to change it. Overall, a very bad experience. I would not recommend this place, especially for couples.

I would strongly suggest that you do not book this hotel and look for alternatives. Many times, you will find this place to be a safety hazard, with police entering without any notice. Even the reception staff are often unresponsive. The service is extremely poor, and there is no cleanliness in the rooms. The place feels shady, as some rooms are booked without any formal record.

It appears they operate under two names; one being FabHotel. Even if you make a booking through FabHotel, they may deny your entry, claiming the rooms have been given to someone they know. I strongly recommend choosing another nearby property instead.

It's most likely a fake property. It's location is just a back alley in a shady residential area. I reached the location and could not find the hotel. Called their number multiple times to ask them to send someone to find me and they confirmed that their staff was on the way, I waited 20 minutes but nobody arrived. I was feeling unsafe, so left the place to a more public and well lit area. Do NOT book this hotel. It's fake.
